artifacts.name: FCOA Canonical Memory & Intelligence Fabric Node

capability_deltas: All FUSE work now treats task limits, quotas, rate limits, concurrency ceilings, storage ceilings and provider-capacity messages as route constraints rather than mission-terminal failures.
Constraint interception maps into the existing OF50 friction lineage as RATE_OR_QUOTA_PRESSURE and forces CHANGED_ROUTE_REQUIRED while preserving the mission objective and terminal predicates.

For active-task limits, FUSE first reuses a semantically equivalent existing automation, then may consolidate only exact-equivalent duplicates, then tries FUSE/provider/local schedulers; otherwise the mission is retained in a durable queue without owner burden.
Repeated recurrence on the same constrained route forbids unchanged retry and requires a different route family or mechanism.
Automatic re-routing may never pause/delete unrelated work merely to free capacity, and it never widens provider/external-effect authority.

llm_context.automation_limit_rule: REUSE_EQUIVALENT_EXISTING_TASK > CONSOLIDATE_ONLY_EXACT_EQUIVALENTS > FUSE_INTERNAL_SCHEDULER > PROVIDER_NATIVE_SCHEDULER > LOCAL_SCHEDULER > DURABLE_QUEUE

route_deltas: Intercept limit/quota/capacity errors before user-visible terminal failure and classify the exact constraint.
Preserve mission identity, objective, schedule/condition semantics, privacy and effect authority while selecting a changed route.
For automation-cap errors, prefer equivalent task reuse; consolidate only semantically identical duplicates; never auto-disable unrelated tasks.
For rate/quota/provider capacity, use a qualified alternate provider/local runtime or changed scheduling mechanism; do not blindly retry the same family after recurrence.
If no semantically equivalent live route exists, append the mission to the durable mission queue and continue route harvesting/capacity recovery without converting it into a manual owner task.
A constraint message is evidence about one execution surface; it is not evidence that the mission or capability is impossible.
summary: Make quota/limit/capacity messages a global automatic re-routing trigger across FUSE while preserving mission semantics, unrelated work and authority boundaries.
warnings: Platform-specific hard limits still exist; FUSE re-routes around them when a qualified alternate route exists but cannot change the platform's own quota.
Unrelated active automations are never paused or deleted automatically simply to free a slot.
Durable queue state preserves work but is not a completion claim.
